integrity: The proof derives the nonlinear kernel from the trace pairing and the field generated by the scalar complement. A standalone finite-field checker verifies subgroup generation, span dimensions, trace-kernel sizes, the complete formula, and parameter recovery in six prime and nonprime cases.
scientific_limitations: The rigidity theorem is relative to scalar affine Frobenius groups and does not claim global pseudo-algebra rigidity.
General fixed-point-free cyclic modules can have several irreducible constituents and require a different kernel analysis.
The standard Frobenius parametrization of irreducible characters is prior theory; the new content is the exact codegree/multiplicity formula and parameter recovery.
title: Scalar affine Frobenius groups are rigid under the group pseudo-algebra
